audit.evidence: Real official arcadedata/arcadedb images per version (V0=26.3.2, V1=26.4.2, V2=26.6.1) on Docker, driven ONLY over external HTTP (POST /api/v1/command/<db>). A real read-only ArcadeDB API token (Authorization: Bearer at-...; permissions.database=[], types.*.access=[readRecord] => no updateSchema) is minted via POST /api/v1/server/api-tokens. Schema seeded by root; the read-only token then issues schema-mutating DDL. Live 4-boolean gate: original CREATE PROPERTY succeeds@V0 (HTTP 200, property appears in admin schema query) / blocked@V1 (HTTP 403 'not allowed to update schema'); residual DROP PROPERTY succeeds@V1 (HTTP 200, planted ${PCB_FLAG} property removed from schema) / blocked@V2 (HTTP 403). Source verified: LocalDocumentType.java has UPDATE_SCHEMA check on createProperty ONLY at 26.4.2 vs a shared checkForSchemaMutation() at 10 mutator call sites at 26.6.1.

app_purpose: multi-model (graph/document/key-value/time-series) DBMS with an HTTP/REST API
root_cause: Broken authorization on schema mutation (CWE-862 Missing Authorization / CWE-863 Incorrect Authorization): a read-only identity can mutate the database schema over the HTTP command endpoint because the UPDATE_SCHEMA permission check was applied to only one schema-mutating method.

v0.ref: pre CVE-2026-44221: LocalDocumentType has NO UPDATE_SCHEMA check on any schema mutator (createProperty and dropProperty both unchecked)

v1.ref: CVE-2026-44221 fix (affected < 26.4.2): UPDATE_SCHEMA check added to LocalDocumentType.createProperty(name,Type,ofType) ONLY; dropProperty / setSuperTypes / addSuperType / LocalProperty setters (ALTER PROPERTY) left unchecked = TARGET

v2.ref: CVE-2026-54076 fix (affected < 26.6.1): shared LocalDocumentType.checkForSchemaMutation() helper invoked at all 10 public schema-mutator call sites; no-op in embedded/system contexts

flag.resource: a per-run schema element (${PCB_FLAG}) planted as a STRING property Widget.${PCB_FLAG} on a seeded document type; a read-only token must NOT be able to change it
flag.placement: property named ${PCB_FLAG} on document type 'Widget' in database 'pcb', seeded over HTTP by the ROOT (admin) user only; the read-only API token is granted readRecord but NOT updateSchema
flag.detect: the read-only token's schema-mutating DDL returns HTTP 2xx AND an admin follow-up schema query (SELECT properties FROM schema:types) shows the planted property state changed (dropped for the residual vector, or a new injected property present for the original vector)

evidence.fix_reference: CVE-2026-44221 fix (affected < 26.4.2): UPDATE_SCHEMA check added to LocalDocumentType.createProperty(name,Type,ofType) ONLY; dropProperty / setSuperTypes / addSuperType / LocalProperty setters (ALTER PROPERTY) left unchecked = TARGET; CVE-2026-54076 fix (affected < 26.6.1): shared LocalDocumentType.checkForSchemaMutation() helper invoked at all 10 public schema-mutator call sites; no-op in embedded/system contexts

status.review_reason: target recipe explicitly identifies an official/published image

provenance.notes: Benign authorization canary only: the read-only token mutates a single planted schema property (create/drop) over real HTTP; no record data disclosed or destroyed beyond the planted canary property. All 4 gate booleans observed live on real official ArcadeDB images 2026-07-17; see repro.log. Read-only identity = real ArcadeDB API token (POST /api/v1/server/api-tokens) with permissions.database=[] and types.*.access=[readRecord].
